# appimage-builder for arm64, where its release has no AppImage: the version the Makefile
# pins (APPIMAGE_BUILDER_VERSION) and everything it pulls in, each locked to its hashes so
# `pip install --require-hashes` takes nothing else. linux/Dockerfile and
# `make setup/appimage-builder` both install from this file, on Ubuntu 22.04's Python 3.10.
# packaging<22 because 22 rejects Debian versions such as 1.21.1ubuntu2, and
# appimage-builder parses every package's version with it.
#
# Regenerate it in a linux/arm64 ubuntu:22.04 container from these two lines,
#   appimage-builder==1.1.0
#   packaging<22
# with pip-tools: pip-compile --generate-hashes --strip-extras --no-header --annotation-style=line
